# CalculateAnything

> Free, fast, privacy-first online calculators, converters, and developer utilities running directly in your browser without sign-ups or servers.

CalculateAnything is an open web suite of 110+ calculation and conversion tools designed for accuracy, speed, and privacy. Every tool operates 100% on the client side inside the browser, meaning sensitive numbers, financial data, images, text, and documents never leave the user's device.

## Core Categories

- [Date & Age Calculators](https://calculate-anything.in/category/date-age/): Tools for birthdays, age differences, elapsed days, working days, and time intervals.
- [Finance & Business Calculators](https://calculate-anything.in/category/finance/): Loan EMI, SIP, mutual funds, interest rates, salary breakdown, and tax estimations.
- [Mathematics Calculators](https://calculate-anything.in/category/mathematics/): Scientific calculations, percentages, fractions, standard deviations, and ratios.
- [Developer Tools](https://calculate-anything.in/category/developer/): JSON formatters, Base64 encoders, UUID generators, regex testers, hash generators, and JWT decoders.
- [Unit & Conversion Tools](https://calculate-anything.in/category/unit-conversion/): Converters for length, weight, temperature, data storage, speed, area, and volume.
- [Text & Formatting Tools](https://calculate-anything.in/category/text-formatting/): Text case changers, difference checkers, word counters, and Markdown tools.
- [Image & File Tools](https://calculate-anything.in/category/image-file/): In-browser image compressor, resizer, cropper, WebP converter, and PDF utilities.
- [Random & Productivity Tools](https://calculate-anything.in/category/productivity/): Pomodoro timer, stopwatch, password generator, and randomizers.

## Popular Tools

- [Age Calculator](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/age-calculator/): Calculate your exact age in years, months, days, hours, and minutes from your date of birth. Find out how many days until your next birthday.
- [Scientific Calculator](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/scientific-calculator/): A full-featured scientific calculator with trigonometric, logarithmic, exponential, and statistical functions for advanced mathematical computations.
- [BMI Calculator](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/bmi-calculator/): Calculate your Body Mass Index (BMI) using height and weight in metric or imperial units, with a health classification result.
- [Rich Text Editor](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/rich-text-editor/): Full-featured WYSIWYG rich text editor powered by open-source TinyMCE. Format text, insert tables, media, code, and export to HTML or plain text offline.
- [JSON Formatter](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/json-formatter/): Beautify, minify, and validate JSON data instantly. Supports syntax highlighting and error detection for malformed JSON.
- [Hash Generator](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/hash-generator/): Generate MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, and SHA-512 cryptographic hashes from any text or file input instantly.
- [QR Code Generator](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/qr-code-generator/): Create custom QR codes for URLs, text, Wi-Fi passwords, vCards, and emails. Download high-resolution vector SVG or PNG images instantly.
- [Password Generator](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/password-generator/): Generate strong, secure passwords with custom length, character sets, symbols, and numbers. Includes strength indicator.
- [Temperature Converter](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/temperature-converter/): Convert temperatures instantly between Celsius (°C), Fahrenheit (°F), Kelvin (K), and Rankine (°R) with step-by-step conversion formulas.

## All Tools

### Date & Age Calculators

- [Age Calculator](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/age-calculator/): Calculate your exact age in years, months, days, hours, and minutes from your date of birth. Find out how many days until your next birthday.
- [Age Difference Calculator](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/age-difference-calculator/): Find the exact age difference between two people or two dates. Displays the gap in years, months, and days.
- [Date Difference Calculator](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/date-difference-calculator/): Calculate the number of days, weeks, months, and years between any two dates. Useful for project timelines and event planning.
- [Date Add/Subtract Calculator](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/date-add-subtract/): Add or subtract days, weeks, months, or years from any date. Instantly calculate past or future target dates with calendar leap year support.
- [Days Until Calculator](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/days-until-calculator/): Calculate exactly how many days, hours, and minutes remain until any upcoming event, holiday, birthday, or deadline with instant countdown.
- [Birthday Calculator](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/birthday-calculator/): Discover what day of the week you were born, your birth number, next birthday countdown, and upcoming birthdays for any date.
- [Leap Year Checker](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/leap-year-checker/): Quickly check whether any given year is a leap year and find the nearest past and future leap years.
- [Working Days Calculator](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/working-days-calculator/): Calculate the number of business (working) days between two dates, excluding weekends and optional public holidays.
- [Time Duration Calculator](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/time-duration-calculator/): Add or subtract time values and calculate the total duration between two time points in hours, minutes, and seconds.
- [Unix Timestamp Converter](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/unix-timestamp-converter/): Convert Unix timestamps to human-readable dates and vice versa. Supports millisecond and second precision.

### Mathematics Calculators

- [Scientific Calculator](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/scientific-calculator/): A full-featured scientific calculator with trigonometric, logarithmic, exponential, and statistical functions for advanced mathematical computations.
- [Percentage Calculator](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/percentage-calculator/): Calculate percentages, percentage change, percentage of a number, and reverse percentages with ease.
- [Fraction Calculator](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/fraction-calculator/): Add, subtract, multiply, and divide fractions and mixed numbers. Automatically simplifies results to the lowest terms.
- [Ratio Calculator](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/ratio-calculator/): Simplify ratios, find equivalent ratios, and solve proportions for A:B = C:D. Free online math ratio solver with step-by-step simplification.
- [Average Calculator](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/average-calculator/): Compute the mean, median, mode, and range for any list of numbers. Great for statistics and data analysis.
- [Square Root Calculator](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/square-root-calculator/): Calculate the square root, cube root, or any nth root of a number instantly with step-by-step explanation.
- [Power Calculator](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/power-calculator/): Calculate a base raised to any exponent, including negative and fractional powers, with detailed results.
- [Prime Number Checker](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/prime-number-checker/): Check whether a number is prime or composite, and find all prime factors with a complete factorization breakdown.
- [LCM & HCF Calculator](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/lcm-hcf-calculator/): Find the Least Common Multiple (LCM) and Highest Common Factor (HCF / GCD) of two or more numbers instantly with step-by-step prime factorizations.
- [Factorial Calculator](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/factorial-calculator/): Calculate the factorial (n!) of any non-negative integer with precision. Includes permutation and combination formulas for math and probability.
- [Random Number Generator](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/random-number-generator/): Generate one or multiple random numbers within a custom range. Supports integers and decimal values.
- [BMI Calculator](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/bmi-calculator/): Calculate your Body Mass Index (BMI) using height and weight in metric or imperial units, with a health classification result.
- [GPA Calculator](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/gpa-calculator/): Calculate your cumulative and semester GPA easily. Enter course grades and credit hours to determine your grade point average on standard 4.0 scale.
- [Standard Deviation Calculator](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/standard-deviation-calculator/): Compute the population and sample standard deviation, variance, and other descriptive statistics for a dataset.
- [Profit & Loss Calculator](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/profit-loss-calculator/): Calculate profit, loss, profit percentage, and loss margin given cost price and selling price. Essential financial tool for business and trading.

### Text & Formatting Tools

- [Rich Text Editor](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/rich-text-editor/): Full-featured WYSIWYG rich text editor powered by open-source TinyMCE. Format text, insert tables, media, code, and export to HTML or plain text offline.
- [JSON Formatter](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/json-formatter/): Beautify, minify, and validate JSON data instantly. Supports syntax highlighting and error detection for malformed JSON.
- [Text Case Converter](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/text-case-converter/): Convert text between uppercase, lowercase, title case, sentence case, camelCase, snake_case, and kebab-case.
- [Word & Character Counter](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/word-character-counter/): Count words, characters (with and without spaces), sentences, paragraphs, and lines in any block of text.
- [Text Difference Checker](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/text-difference-checker/): Compare two blocks of text side-by-side and highlight the differences line by line, word by word, or character by character.
- [Text Formatter](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/text-formatter/): Remove extra spaces, fix line breaks, trim whitespace, and clean up pasted text from documents or PDFs.
- [Markdown Previewer](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/markdown-previewer/): Write Markdown and see a live formatted preview side-by-side. Supports tables, code blocks, images, and GFM extensions.
- [HTML Formatter](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/html-formatter/): Beautify, format, and minify HTML markup instantly. Clean up messy code with customizable indentation, tag formatting, and syntax validation.
- [CSS Formatter](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/css-formatter/): Beautify, format, and minify CSS code online. Clean up stylesheets with custom indentation, CSS property sorting, and syntax error checking.
- [JavaScript Formatter](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/javascript-formatter/): Format, beautify, and clean up JavaScript and TypeScript code online with configurable indentation, bracket spacing, and syntax highlighting.
- [XML Formatter](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/xml-formatter/): Format, beautify, and validate XML documents online. Clean up messy XML feeds and files with structured indentation and tree hierarchy view.
- [SQL Formatter](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/sql-formatter/): Format and beautify SQL queries with proper indentation and keyword capitalization for better readability.
- [URL Encoder/Decoder](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/url-encoder-decoder/): Encode special characters in URLs for safe transmission or decode percent-encoded URLs back to plain text.
- [Base64 Encoder/Decoder](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/base64-encoder-decoder/): Encode plain text or binary data to Base64 format and decode Base64 strings back to their original content.
- [HTML Entity Encoder/Decoder](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/html-entity-encoder-decoder/): Encode special characters into HTML entities or decode entity codes back to plain text. Supports named, decimal, and hexadecimal formats.
- [Lorem Ipsum Generator](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/lorem-ipsum-generator/): Generate placeholder Lorem Ipsum text by paragraphs, sentences, words, or bytes for use in design mockups and prototypes.

### Developer Tools

- [JWT Decoder](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/jwt-decoder/): Decode and inspect JSON Web Tokens (JWT) to view the header, payload, and signature without needing a secret key.
- [Regex Tester](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/regex-tester/): Test and debug regular expressions against sample text in real time, with match highlighting and group capture details.
- [UUID Generator](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/uuid-generator/): Generate RFC-compliant UUIDs (v1, v4) in bulk. Copy individual or multiple UUIDs with a single click.
- [Cron Expression Generator](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/cron-expression-generator/): Build and validate cron expressions visually. Instantly see the next scheduled run times for any cron schedule.
- [Hash Generator](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/hash-generator/): Generate MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, and SHA-512 cryptographic hashes from any text or file input instantly.
- [Color Code Converter](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/color-code-converter/): Convert color codes between HEX, RGB, HSL, HSV, and CMYK formats with an interactive visual color picker and real-time live preview.
- [CSS Gradient Generator](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/css-gradient-generator/): Design linear, radial, and conic CSS gradients visually. Adjust color stops, angles, and blend modes, then copy cross-browser CSS code.
- [QR Code Generator](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/qr-code-generator/): Create custom QR codes for URLs, text, Wi-Fi passwords, vCards, and emails. Download high-resolution vector SVG or PNG images instantly.
- [Password Generator](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/password-generator/): Generate strong, secure passwords with custom length, character sets, symbols, and numbers. Includes strength indicator.
- [SQL Query Formatter](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/sql-query-formatter/): Format and indent complex SQL queries for improved readability. Supports MySQL, PostgreSQL, and standard SQL dialects.
- [HTTP Status Code Lookup](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/http-status-code-lookup/): Quickly look up HTTP status codes (1xx, 2xx, 3xx, 4xx, 5xx). View official RFC definitions, causes, and troubleshooting guidelines.
- [MIME Type Lookup](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/mime-type-lookup/): Search MIME types by file extension or find associated extensions by media type. Complete directory for web developers and API designers.
- [IP Address Information Tool](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/ip-address-info/): Look up geolocation, ISP, and network details for any IP address (IPv4 or IPv6). Also detects your current IP.
- [User-Agent Parser](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/user-agent-parser/): Parse any User-Agent string to identify the browser, operating system, device type, and engine details.
- [HTML to Markdown Converter](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/html-to-markdown-converter/): Convert HTML markup to clean Markdown syntax, preserving headings, lists, links, tables, and inline formatting.
- [JSON to CSV Converter](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/json-to-csv-converter/): Convert JSON arrays to CSV format and download the resulting file for use in spreadsheets or data tools.
- [CSV to JSON Converter](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/csv-to-json-converter/): Convert CSV data to clean JSON format online with automatic header detection, custom delimiters, and formatted or minified output options.
- [JSON Schema Validator](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/json-schema-validator/): Validate JSON data against a JSON Schema (Draft-07 or later) and get detailed error messages for invalid fields.
- [SVG Optimizer](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/svg-optimizer/): Optimize and minify SVG files by removing unnecessary metadata, comments, and redundant elements to reduce file size.
- [API Request Builder](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/api-request-builder/): Build and send HTTP requests (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) with custom headers, query params, and body. View formatted responses.

### Unit & Conversion Tools

- [Length Converter](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/length-converter/): Convert length and distance between meters, feet, inches, miles, kilometers, yards, and nautical units with real-time bidirectional conversion.
- [Weight Converter](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/weight-converter/): Convert weight and mass between kilograms, pounds (lbs), grams, ounces (oz), stones, and tons with instant, high-precision calculations.
- [Temperature Converter](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/temperature-converter/): Convert temperatures instantly between Celsius (°C), Fahrenheit (°F), Kelvin (K), and Rankine (°R) with step-by-step conversion formulas.
- [Data Storage Converter](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/data-storage-converter/): Convert between bits, bytes, kilobytes, megabytes, gigabytes, terabytes, and beyond using binary or decimal prefixes.
- [Speed Converter](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/speed-converter/): Convert speed between km/h, mph, m/s, knots, and other velocity units for travel, physics, and engineering.
- [Time Converter](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/time-converter/): Convert between seconds, minutes, hours, days, weeks, months, and years with high precision. Ideal for time tracking, billing, and scheduling.
- [Area Converter](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/area-converter/): Convert between square meters, square feet, acres, hectares, square kilometers, and many more area units.
- [Volume Converter](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/volume-converter/): Convert volume between liters, milliliters, gallons, fluid ounces, pints, cups, cubic meters, and cubic feet with instant calculation.
- [Number to Words Converter](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/number-to-words-converter/): Convert any number to its English word representation. Useful for writing cheques or formal documents.
- [Roman Numeral Converter](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/roman-numeral-converter/): Convert numbers between Arabic numerals and Roman numerals (1 to 3,999). Includes explanation of Roman numeral rules and calculation breakdown.

### Finance & Business Calculators

- [EMI Calculator](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/emi-calculator/): Calculate your monthly EMI for home, car, or personal loans based on principal, interest rate, and tenure. Includes amortization schedule.
- [GST Calculator](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/gst-calculator/): Calculate GST-inclusive and GST-exclusive prices for different GST slabs (5%, 12%, 18%, 28%). Shows CGST, SGST, and IGST breakdowns.
- [SIP Calculator](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/sip-calculator/): Calculate the future value of your Systematic Investment Plan (SIP) investments and estimate returns over time.
- [FD Calculator](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/fd-calculator/): Calculate the maturity amount and interest earned on a Fixed Deposit for different compounding frequencies.
- [RD Calculator](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/rd-calculator/): Calculate the maturity value of a Recurring Deposit by entering the monthly deposit amount, interest rate, and tenure.
- [Simple Interest Calculator](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/simple-interest-calculator/): Calculate simple interest (SI = P×R×T/100) and total accumulated amount for any principal, annual interest rate, and duration in years or months.
- [Compound Interest Calculator](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/compound-interest-calculator/): Calculate compound interest with different compounding frequencies (daily, monthly, quarterly, annually) and see the power of compounding.
- [Discount Calculator](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/discount-calculator/): Calculate the discounted price, discount amount, and savings percentage for any original price and discount rate.
- [Salary Calculator](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/salary-calculator/): Convert salary between hourly, daily, weekly, monthly, and annual figures. Includes basic tax and deduction estimations.
- [Income Tax Calculator](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/income-tax-calculator/): Estimate your income tax liability under the old and new tax regimes for the current financial year.

### Image & File Tools

- [Image Compressor](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/image-compressor/): Compress JPEG, PNG, and WebP images in the browser without uploading to a server. Adjust quality and see real-time size reduction.
- [Image Resizer](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/image-resizer/): Resize images to exact pixel dimensions or by percentage while maintaining aspect ratio. Download the resized image instantly.
- [Image to PDF Converter](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/image-to-pdf-converter/): Convert one or multiple images (JPG, PNG, WebP) into a single PDF document. Control page size and orientation.
- [PDF Merger](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/pdf-merger/): Combine multiple PDF files into one document in seconds. Reorder pages with drag-and-drop in your browser with 100% client-side privacy.
- [PDF Splitter](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/pdf-splitter/): Split PDF documents into separate pages or extract specific page ranges securely in your browser. Fast, private, with zero upload to any server.
- [Background Remover](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/background-remover/): Automatically remove the background from photos using AI-powered segmentation, all processed client-side for privacy.
- [PNG to JPG Converter](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/png-to-jpg-converter/): Convert PNG images to JPG format with adjustable quality settings. Handles transparency by applying a background color.
- [JPG to PNG Converter](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/jpg-to-png-converter/): Convert JPG and JPEG images to high-quality PNG format online. Runs completely client-side in your browser for total privacy and instant downloads.
- [WebP Converter](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/webp-converter/): Convert images to and from WebP format for fast web performance. Reduce file size while keeping crisp quality directly in your browser.
- [Image Cropper](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/image-cropper/): Crop images to any size or aspect ratio using an interactive drag-and-drop interface. Download the cropped image instantly.
- [Favicon Generator](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/favicon-generator/): Generate complete favicon packages (ICO, PNG 16x16 to 512x512, Apple touch icons) from any image with HTML link tags ready to copy.
- [QR Code Scanner](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/qr-code-scanner/): Scan and decode QR codes from an uploaded image or directly from your webcam using the browser camera.
- [PDF Page Counter](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/pdf-page-counter/): Count pages in any PDF document instantly and inspect file size, page dimensions, and document metadata completely client-side in your browser.
- [PDF to Image Converter](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/pdf-to-image-converter/): Extract and convert PDF pages into high-resolution PNG or JPG images. Download single pages or all pages packaged as a ZIP archive.
- [Image Metadata Viewer](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/image-metadata-viewer/): View EXIF, IPTC, and XMP metadata from JPEG and TIFF images. See camera settings, GPS coordinates, and more.

### Random & Productivity Tools

- [Random Name Picker](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/random-name-picker/): Enter a list of names and randomly pick one or more winners. Perfect for giveaways, classroom selections, and team decisions.
- [Random Password Generator](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/random-password-generator/): Generate secure, randomized passwords in bulk with customizable length, symbols, numbers, and uppercase letters. Fast and completely client-side.
- [Random Team Generator](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/random-team-generator/): Quickly generate balanced random teams or groups from any list of names. Perfect for classrooms, sports, hackathons, and office activities.
- [Decision Maker](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/decision-maker/): Enter your choices and let the Decision Maker randomly pick one for you. Supports Yes/No, custom options, and weighted choices.
- [Stopwatch](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/stopwatch/): Accurate online stopwatch with split lap times, pause/resume, keyboard shortcuts, and export options. Free and runs smoothly in any web browser.
- [Countdown Timer](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/countdown-timer/): Set a custom countdown timer with an audio alert when it reaches zero. Supports hours, minutes, and seconds.
- [Pomodoro Timer](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/pomodoro-timer/): Boost your focus with the Pomodoro technique. Customizable work and break intervals with session tracking.
- [Meeting Time Calculator](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/meeting-time-calculator/): Find the best meeting time across multiple time zones. Enter participants and their locations to calculate overlap.
- [Checklist Generator](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/checklist-generator/): Create interactive checklists, to-do lists, and task trackers. Save progress to local storage and export as PDF or text.
- [Text to Speech](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/text-to-speech/): Convert written text to audio using the browser's Web Speech API. Choose from available voices, speed, and pitch.
- [Speech to Text](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/speech-to-text/): Transcribe your voice to text in real time using the browser's Web Speech Recognition API. No sign-up required.
- [Typing Speed Test](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/typing-speed-test/): Measure your typing speed in WPM (words per minute) and accuracy with timed typing tests and performance history.
- [Password Strength Checker](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/password-strength-checker/): Evaluate password strength instantly with entropy analysis, common pattern detection, and improvement suggestions.
- [Reading Time Calculator](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/reading-time-calculator/): Estimate the reading time for any article or document based on word count and average reading speed.
- [Internet Speed Unit Converter](https://calculate-anything.in/tools/internet-speed-unit-converter/): Convert between internet speed units: Kbps, Mbps, Gbps, KB/s, MB/s, and GB/s. Calculate download time for any file size.
